description: UITKX element and directive schema for IDE tooling

structuralAttributes.name: key
structuralAttributes.description: Unique reconciler key. Stabilises element identity across re-renders.

structuralAttributes.name: ref
structuralAttributes.description: Forwarded ref. On built-in elements receives the underlying VisualElement; user components must declare a Ref<T> parameter to accept it.

intrinsicElementAttributes.name: contentContainer
intrinsicElementAttributes.description: Props forwarded to the inner content container.

intrinsicElementAttributes.name: focusable
intrinsicElementAttributes.description: Whether the element can receive focus.

intrinsicElementAttributes.name: delegatesFocus
intrinsicElementAttributes.description: Whether focus is delegated to a child.

intrinsicElementAttributes.name: extraProps
intrinsicElementAttributes.description: Arbitrary extra props forwarded to the element.

intrinsicElementAttributes.name: onGenerateVisualContent
intrinsicElementAttributes.description: Custom rendering callback. Receives a MeshGenerationContext; use ctx.painter2D for vector drawing (lines, arcs, beziers) or ctx.Allocate for raw vertex/index meshes. Treat the element as read-only inside the callback. Re-runs on repaint, triggered automatically when the callback reference or RedrawKey changes.

intrinsicElementAttributes.name: redrawKey
intrinsicElementAttributes.description: Bump this value to force OnGenerateVisualContent to repaint without changing the callback (pair with a stable callback, e.g. useStableCallback).

directives.name: namespace
directives.description: C# namespace override for the generated types (rare escape hatch — namespaces are file-keyed by default).

directives.name: using
directives.description: Adds a using directive to the generated file. Prefer the unified `import "@Namespace"` spelling (they are equivalent).

directives.name: uss
directives.description: Attaches a USS stylesheet to the component root element. Path is relative to the .uitkx file.

directives.name: backend
directives.description: Selects the render backend for this file: 'ugui' for the uGUI vocabulary (RectTransform anchors, sprites, TMP text), or 'uitk' (the default UI Toolkit vocabulary). One per file, before any declaration.

controlFlow.name: switch
controlFlow.description: Switch expression — generates a C# switch expression.

controlFlow.name: for
controlFlow.description: C-style for loop — generates a standard for loop.

controlFlow.name: while
controlFlow.description: While loop — generates a while loop.

Label.description: Renders a text label (VisualElement wrapping a text element).

attributes.name: enableRichText
attributes.description: Whether rich text tags in the label text are parsed (UI Toolkit default: true).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: VisualElement.name for USS or code queries.

attributes.name: className
attributes.description: One or more USS class names (space-separated).

attributes.name: contentContainer
attributes.description: Props for the inner content container.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Label text shown beside the toggle.

Audio.description: Side-effect-only Func-Component that rents a pooled UnityEngine.AudioSource from MediaHost. Renders no visible content. Use for music tracks and configurable per-instance audio (positional, looping, with imperative controller). For fire-and-forget UI clicks, prefer the useSfx() hook.

attributes.name: Autoplay
attributes.description: Start playback on mount. Default: true.

Video.description: Real positionable Func-Component that rents a pooled UnityEngine.Video.VideoPlayer and a pooled RenderTexture from MediaHost, writes the video into the host VisualElement's style.backgroundImage. Accepts overlay children (e.g. play/pause buttons).

attributes.name: Url
attributes.description: Streaming URL alternative to Clip (HTTP, file://). Wins over Clip when both are set.

attributes.name: Autoplay
attributes.description: Begin playback once prepared. Default: true.

attributes.name: ScaleMode
attributes.description: scaleToFit (default) | scaleAndCrop | stretchToFill — maps to BackgroundSize.

attributes.name: AudioOutputMode
attributes.description: How VideoPlayer outputs audio. Default: Direct.

attributes.name: MixerGroup
attributes.description: Optional mixer group when AudioOutputMode is AudioSource.

attributes.name: OnPrepared
attributes.description: Fired once the player has finished preparing.

attributes.name: OnError
attributes.description: Fired with error message if VideoPlayer reports one.

attributes.name: fixedItemHeight
attributes.description: Height of each row in pixels.

attributes.name: makeItem
attributes.description: Factory callback that creates a row VisualElement.

attributes.name: bindItem
attributes.description: Callback that binds data to a row element.

attributes.name: unbindItem
attributes.description: Callback invoked when a row is recycled.

HelpBox.description: Info, warning, or error message box.

attributes.name: selectedIndexChanged
attributes.description: Callback when selected tab changes — delegate void(int index).

RadioButton.description: Single radio button in a group.

RadioButtonGroup.description: Container managing a set of radio buttons.

attributes.name: enumType
attributes.description: Assembly-qualified name of the enum type, e.g. typeof(TextAnchor).AssemblyQualifiedName.

VisualElement.description: Bare VisualElement — generic container with arbitrary props.

VisualElementSafe.description: VisualElement that automatically applies safe-area insets (notch, status bar, etc.).

Text.description: Shorthand for a plain text label.

Router.description: Root router component. Provides routing context to all descendant Route/Link components.

attributes.name: history
attributes.description: Custom history implementation (defaults to in-memory history).

attributes.name: basename
attributes.description: Optional URL prefix the router treats as the root (default '/').

Route.description: Renders its children/element only when the current location matches the given path. When both 'element' and child <Route>s are supplied it acts as a layout route — the matched child is forwarded to the descendant <Outlet/>.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: URL path pattern to match (supports :param and *).

attributes.name: exact
attributes.description: When true the path must match exactly.

attributes.name: element
attributes.description: VirtualNode to render when the route matches.

attributes.name: index
attributes.description: Index route — matches the parent pattern exactly with no extra segment.

attributes.name: caseSensitive
attributes.description: When true, segment comparison is case-sensitive (default: case-insensitive).

Link.description: Navigates to the given path when clicked.

attributes.name: replace
attributes.description: Replace history entry instead of pushing.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Arbitrary navigation state passed to the target.

Outlet.description: Render-slot for nested routes. A parent <Route element=...> with child <Route>s publishes the matched child here. Outside any <Router> it renders nothing.

attributes.name: context
attributes.description: Optional value handed to descendants via UseOutletContext<T>().

Routes.description: First-match-wins selector. Walks child <Route> declarations, ranks them with React-Router-style scoring (static > dynamic > splat), and renders the highest-ranked match.

NavLink.description: Navigation link that applies an active style when its target matches the current location.

attributes.name: replace
attributes.description: Replace history entry instead of pushing.

attributes.name: end
attributes.description: When true, only activate on an exact location match.

attributes.name: activeStyle
attributes.description: Style applied when the target matches the current location.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Arbitrary navigation state passed to the target.

Navigate.description: Declarative redirect. When mounted, navigates to <to> exactly once. Defaults to history.replace.

attributes.name: replace
attributes.description: When true (default), replaces the current history entry instead of pushing.

Suspense.description: Shows a fallback while content is loading; switches to children once ready.

attributes.name: isReady
attributes.description: Delegate that returns true when content is ready to render.

attributes.name: fallback
attributes.description: VirtualNode rendered while the content is not yet ready.

Portal.description: Renders children into a different VisualElement target, outside the normal component tree.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: The VisualElement into which children are rendered.

Fragment.description: Invisible wrapper that allows returning multiple root elements.

BoundsField.description: Editor field for a Bounds (center + size) value.

BoundsIntField.description: Editor field for a BoundsInt value.

DoubleField.description: Editor field for a double value.

EnumFlagsField.description: Editor dropdown for a [Flags] enum value.

GUIDField.description: Text field for a UnityEngine.GUID value. Runtime-usable since Unity 6.4.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current GUID. Accepts a GUID or a dashed/undashed hex string.

attributes.name: isDelayed
attributes.description: Commit the value on Enter/blur instead of per keystroke.

attributes.name: selectAllOnFocus
attributes.description: Select the whole value when the field gains focus.

MaskField.description: Multi-select bitmask dropdown (32-bit). Runtime-usable since Unity 6.5.

attributes.name: choices
attributes.description: Option labels. The dropdown prefixes 'Nothing' and 'Everything'.

attributes.name: choicesMasks
attributes.description: Per-choice mask overriding the default 1 << i, for composite flags.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current mask. 'Nothing' is 0 and 'Everything' is ~0 (-1), not (1 << n) - 1.

Mask64Field.description: Multi-select bitmask dropdown (64-bit). Runtime-usable since Unity 6.5.

attributes.name: choices
attributes.description: Option labels. The dropdown prefixes 'Nothing' and 'Everything'.

attributes.name: choicesMasks
attributes.description: Per-choice mask overriding the default 1UL << i, for composite flags.

IMGUIContainer.description: Hosts an IMGUI (OnGUI) callback inside UI Toolkit.

InspectorElement.description: Renders the default inspector for a serialized object (editor only).

LongField.description: Editor field for a long value.

MinMaxSlider.description: Slider with a draggable min-max range.

attributes.name: minValue
attributes.description: Current lower bound of the range.

attributes.name: maxValue
attributes.description: Current upper bound of the range.

MultiColumnListView.description: Virtualized list with multiple sortable columns.

MultiColumnTreeView.description: Virtualized tree with multiple sortable columns.

ObjectField.description: Editor field for a UnityEngine.Object reference.

PropertyField.description: Binds and renders a single SerializedProperty (editor only).

RectField.description: Editor field for a Rect value.

RectIntField.description: Editor field for a RectInt value.

RepeatButton.description: Button that fires repeatedly while held.

TemplateContainer.description: Container instantiated from a UXML template.

ToggleButtonGroup.description: Group of toggle buttons with single or multi selection.

ToolbarBreadcrumbs.description: Breadcrumb trail inside an editor toolbar (editor only).

attributes.name: onItem
attributes.description: Callback when an item is clicked (index).

ToolbarButton.description: Button styled for an editor toolbar (editor only).

ToolbarMenu.description: Dropdown menu button for an editor toolbar (editor only).

attributes.name: populateMenu
attributes.description: Callback that appends actions to the dropdown menu.

ToolbarPopupSearchField.description: Search field with a popup menu for an editor toolbar (editor only).

ToolbarSearchField.description: Search field styled for an editor toolbar (editor only).

ToolbarSpacer.description: Flexible spacer inside an editor toolbar (editor only).

ToolbarToggle.description: Toggle styled for an editor toolbar (editor only).

TwoPaneSplitView.description: Container splitting exactly two children with a draggable divider.

attributes.name: fixedPaneIndex
attributes.description: Index (0 or 1) of the fixed pane.

attributes.name: fixedPaneInitialDimension
attributes.description: Initial size in px of the fixed pane.

UnsignedIntegerField.description: Editor field for a uint value.

UnsignedLongField.description: Editor field for a ulong value.

uguiIntrinsicAttributes.name: ref
uguiIntrinsicAttributes.description: Ref to the GameObject / RectTransform / a Component type.

uguiIntrinsicAttributes.name: anchors
uguiIntrinsicAttributes.description: Anchor preset (the RectTransform preset widget): topLeft, topCenter, topRight, middleLeft, middleCenter, middleRight, bottomLeft, bottomCenter, bottomRight, topStretch, middleStretch, bottomStretch, stretchLeft, stretchCenter, stretchRight, stretch.

uguiIntrinsicAttributes.name: layoutElement
uguiIntrinsicAttributes.description: LayoutElement prop group: min/preferred/flexible width and height, ignoreLayout, layoutPriority.

uguiIntrinsicAttributes.name: pointer
uguiIntrinsicAttributes.description: Low-level pointer/drag/scroll handlers attached via a lazily added bridge component.

uguiIntrinsicAttributes.name: canvasGroup
uguiIntrinsicAttributes.description: CanvasGroup prop group: alpha, interactable, blocksRaycasts, ignoreParentGroups.

uguiIntrinsicAttributes.name: mask
uguiIntrinsicAttributes.description: Stencil Mask prop group (requires a Graphic): showMaskGraphic.

uguiIntrinsicAttributes.name: shadow
uguiIntrinsicAttributes.description: Shadow vertex effect: effectColor, effectDistance, useGraphicAlpha.

uguiIntrinsicAttributes.name: outline
uguiIntrinsicAttributes.description: Outline vertex effect: effectColor, effectDistance, useGraphicAlpha.

Canvas.description: Canvas + CanvasScaler + GraphicRaycaster as one element. Nested canvases isolate batching.

Panel.description: Plain RectTransform container (no Graphic, zero draw cost). Created full-stretch.

Image.description: UnityEngine.UI.Image. raycastTarget defaults to false (raycast hygiene).

Text.description: TextMeshProUGUI text. raycastTarget defaults to false.

attributes.name: spriteAsset
attributes.description: TMP sprite asset for inline sprites.

Button.description: Button + background Image on one GameObject (the menu Button shape). Children are the label content.

Toggle.description: Toggle with Background/Checkmark parts. Controlled: isOn writes without notify.

attributes.name: joinGroup
attributes.description: Auto-join the nearest ancestor ToggleGroup element.

Slider.description: Menu-identical Slider skeleton (Background / Fill / Handle). Controlled: value writes without notify.

Scrollbar.description: Menu-identical Scrollbar skeleton. Controlled: value writes without notify.

ScrollRect.description: ScrollRect with a RectMask2D viewport. The FIRST child is the scroll content (typically a VerticalLayoutGroup with a contentSizeFitter prop group).

Dropdown.description: TMP_Dropdown on the exact menu template (Label/Arrow/Template/Item). Controlled: value writes without notify.

InputField.description: TMP_InputField on the exact menu template. Controlled: text writes via SetTextWithoutNotify.

attributes.name: customCaretColor
attributes.description: Use caretColor instead of the text color.

Prefab.description: Migration bridge: instantiates an existing uGUI prefab inside the reactive tree (full-stretch holder).

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Prefab asset to instantiate; change swaps the instance.

attributes.name: bind
attributes.description: Delivered to every IReactivePrefab.Bind on the instance root when changed.

UitkHost.description: Island: a UI Toolkit subtree rendered to a RenderTexture inside this uGUI tree, with pointer input forwarded.

attributes.name: panel
attributes.description: Themed PanelSettings asset (recommended); a minimal runtime one is created when omitted.

cursor.reason: Unity's UI Toolkit Cursor struct is a Texture2D + hotspot pair with no built-in named-cursor constants (unlike CSS's "pointer"/"default"/etc.), so there is no typed Style.Cursor member. The untyped escape hatch (Style["cursor"] = value, or the (StyleKeys.Key, value) tuple form with a raw "cursor" string) is accepted without a compile error but is silently ignored at runtime.
